description: This file defines the 'FunctionalTestingPluginConfiguration' class, which implements plugin and console configuration interfaces for the OrangeHRM functional testing plugin. It sets up autoloading and registers testing-related console commands if the environment is not production.

classes.name: FunctionalTestingPluginConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for setting up the OrangeHRM functional testing plugin, including autoloading setup and conditional registration of testing commands.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by setting up the PSR-4 autoloader for the namespace and adding the plugin subscriber to the event dispatcher.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers database management commands related to testing savepoints if the application is not in production mode.
